author: Chris Schommer
title: Ben Rice drives in three as Yankees blank Reds
desc: Ben Rice went 2-for-4 in Friday's win over the Reds with a three-run home run.
impact: Rice has caught fire at the plate once again, registering hits in each of his last six contests. The first baseman continues to reward manager Aaron Boone with one of the more explosive bats in the Yankees lineup, slashing .294 with 21 home runs, 52 RBI, 54 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 69 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Cam Schlittler cruises in scoreless outing against Reds
desc: Cam Schlittler allowed four hits while striking out 13 over six scoreless innings in Friday's win over the Reds.
impact: Schlittler continues a strong stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in 11 of his last 12 contests. The right-hander remains an elite starting option for fantasy managers as part of a deep Yankees starting staff, carrying a 1.71 ERA and 0.89 WHIP to go with an 8-3 record and 10.3 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Junior Perez clubs homer in narrow loss
desc: Junior Perez went 2-for-3 in a loss to the Tigers with a solo home run.
impact: Perez has offered mixed results at the plate since being called up, picking up hits in one of two contests. Fantasy managers can leave the 24-year-old off rosters in all formats for the time being.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Randal Grichuk goes deep in loss to Tigers
desc: Randal Grichuk went 2-for-3 in a loss to the Tigers with a solo home run, one double, and one walk.
impact: Grichuk has provided mixed results at the plate so far this month, recording hits in six of 11 contests. The 34-year-old remains one of the more streaky options when in the White Sox lineup for manager Will Venable, slashing .273 with seven homers, 20 RBI, and 18 runs scored across 47 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Erick Fedde labors on mound Friday against Tigers
desc: Erick Fedde allowed two earned runs on four hits and one walk while striking out four over 4 2/3 innings in Friday's 4-3 loss to the Tigers.
impact: Fedde continues a steady stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in each of his last five trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more inconsistent arms on the White Sox staff for manager Will Venable, posting a 4.46 ERA and 1.39 WHIP with a 2-6 record and 1.78 K/BB ratio through 15 appearances.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Miles Mikolas gets tagged for five as Nationals fall 5-2
desc: Miles Mikolas allowed five earned runs on nine hits and one walk while striking out two over six innings in Friday's loss to the Rays.
impact: After Friday's outing, Mikolas owns a 5.47 ERA and 1.28 WHIP with a 2-6 record, 5.2 K/9, 5.47 FIP and a 2.53 K:BB across 16 games. He will likely work in bulk relief in his next outing, slated to be against the Phillies.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Luis Garcia Goes Deep in Loss to Rays
desc: Luis Garcia went 2-for-3 in Friday's 5-2 loss to the Rays with a home run, a run scored and one RBI while striking out once.
impact: After Friday's loss, Garcia is batting .265 with 10 home runs, 46 RBI, 30 runs scored and two stolen bases across 70 games. Garcia ranks in 11th in the NL in batting average and RBI this season.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: CJ Abrams goes deep, but Nats still drop one to Rays
desc: CJ Abrams went 1-for-4 in the loss to the Rays with a home run, a run scored and one RBI.
impact: Through 74 games, he's slashing .284/.367/.513 with 15 homers, 55 RBI, 48 runs and 11 steals. Abrams currently ranks in the top 10 in the NL in runs scored, home runs, RBI, and OPS.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Ryan Helsley coughs up late lead in loss to Dodgers
desc: Ryan Helsley allowed two earned runs on two hits and two walks without recording a strikeout while taking a blown save in the 6-5 defeat.
impact: After Friday's outing, Helsley has a 5.11 ERA and 1.62 WHIP with 7 saves and 2 blown saves across 14 appearances. Helsley has made two appearances since returning from the injured list and neither have been good. He has allowed four earned runs, four hits, and two walks in 1 2/3 innings since rejoining the team.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Trey Gibson battles wildness, fans eight in no-decision
desc: Trey Gibson allowed three earned runs on seven hits and four walks while striking out eight over five innings in Friday's loss to the Dodgers.
impact: After the outing, he owns a 5.81 ERA and 1.71 WHIP with a 1-2 record, 6.8 K/9 and a 1.18 K/BB through five starts. Gibson may not make another start in the rotation if Chris Bassitt (back) is able to come off the injured list.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Pete Alonso pops one, but O's come up short in LA
desc: Pete Alonso went 1-for-4 against the Dodgers with a home run, a run scored and one RBI.
impact: After Friday's loss, Alonso is batting .247 with 17 home runs, 49 RBI, 46 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 77 games. Alonso is hitting .304 with two home runs and five RBI over his last seven games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Gunnar Henderson homers but can't save 6-5 loss to Dodgers
desc: Gunnar Henderson went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Dodgers with a home run, one run scored and two RBI.
impact: After Friday's loss, Henderson is batting .223 with 16 home runs, 38 RBI, 41 runs scored and six stolen bases across 76 games. Henderson has been playing well as of late, hitting just .280 with three home runs and six RBI over his last seven games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Victor Caratini Pops One Despite Twins Loss
desc: Victor Caratini went 1-for-2 in a 9-5 loss to the Diamondbacks on Friday with a home run, two walks, one run scored, and one RBI.
impact: Caratini swatted a solo homer in the second inning to give the Twins a 1-0 lead. After Friday's loss, Caratini is batting .231 with five home runs, 26 RBI, and 14 runs scored across 55 games. He's been hot of late, hitting .370 with three homers and nine RBI over his past 15 contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Josh Bell Keeps It Simple: One Swing, One RBI
desc: Josh Bell went 1-for-4 in a 9-5 loss to the Diamondbacks on Friday with a home run, a run scored, and one RBI.
impact: After Friday's loss, Bell is slashing .244/.299/.396 with nine home runs, 47 RBI, 37 runs scored, and one stolen base across 74 games. Bell has been hot of late, hitting .400 with two homers and nine RBI over his past seven contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Royce Lewis Goes Deep, but Twins Can't Keep Up
desc: Royce Lewis went 1-for-4 in Friday's 9-5 loss to the Diamondbacks with a home run, a run scored and an RBI.
impact: Through 43 games, he's slashing .200/.282/.373 with seven homers, 21 RBI, 18 runs scored, and four steals alongside a .288 wOBA and a .237 BABIP. He's hitting .259 with three homers and seven RBI across his past seven contests.
